explanation: Paris first hosted in 1900, when events were spread over about five months alongside a World's Fair. In 2024 it became the second city to host three times, after London.

claims.text: Paris hosted the Summer Olympics in 1924 and in 2024.
London (1908, 1948, 2012), Los Angeles (1932, 1984) and Amsterdam (1928) did not host the Summer Olympics in both 1924 and 2024.
Paris hosted the 1900 Summer Olympics alongside the 1900 World's Fair, with events spread over about five months.
With the 2024 Games, Paris became the second city to host the Summer Olympics three times, after London.
